# Copilot instructions for `open-geo-service`

Open Geo Service is a FastAPI service that downloads, processes and serves climate, Earth
observation and geospatial data for one configured extent, as GeoZarr stores and GeoParquet
feature collections, through STAC, Zarr over HTTP and openEO.

The project's conventions for any AI assistant are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): repository
layout, dataset templates, development commands, and commit conventions. Follow it; this file
only points there.
